To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effectiveness of a physical activity intervention was dependent upon the fidelity of the intervention.
intervention fidelity was poor in most worksites and that this was associated with a lack of effect of the intervention.

intervention fidelity was poor in 2 organizations, moderate in 2 organizations and good in 1 organization (local council) and that the intervention was effective in increasing physical activity among employees in the council but not in the other 4 organizations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the effectiveness of complex interventions in the context of the workplace.
the development of a new methodology to measure fidelity and its effects on intervention outcomes.
understanding how to improve the delivery of worksite physical activity interventions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intervention was effective in increasing physical activity levels in the worksite where the intervention fidelity was good.
the intervention was effective in increasing physical activity levels in the local council, but not in any of the other four worksites.
the effectiveness of the AME for Activity intervention varied as a function intervention fidelity, and that intervention fidelity should be measured and reported in all worksite interventions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fidelity assessment can help identify the conditions under which complex interventions are most effective, and that this can help inform future interventions.
the intervention was effective in the local council, and that this effectiveness was related to the fidelity with which the intervention was implemented.
the intervention was effective in the local council where the intervention was delivered with fidelity, but not in the other organizations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effectiveness of the intervention was not uniform across worksites and was only effective in one of five organizations.
the evaluation of complex health interventions needs to be conducted in ways that take into account the context in which they are delivered.
intervention fidelity is a key factor in the evaluation of complex worksite interventions, and should be measured as part of a comprehensive evaluation.
